title: S-band thulium-doped fiber amplifier designs of Yucel and Dincer (2022), ref. [88] of rev2.2 ([129] in rev3_assembled.md): OptiSystem simulation study, abstract-level card
model: none in this review. The source simulated single-pass, double-pass and dual-stage triple-pass TDFAs with OptiSystem 18.0; the simulator component and its model options are not stated in the accessible material

device.type: Tm-doped fiber amplifier, simulated, three configurations
device.host: not stated in the accessible material
device.transition: S-band signal on 3H4 -> 3F4 (standard assignment, not stated in the abstract); the abstract states only that the 1050 nm pump provides ground-state and excited-state absorption

reference_plane: not stated in the accessible material
source_full: M. Yucel, A. Dincer, The gain and noise figure comparison of single-pass, double-pass, and dual-stage triple-pass thulium-doped fiber amplifiers in S-band with thulium-doped fiber optimization, Microw. Opt. Technol. Lett. 64(10), 1863-1870 (2022), doi:10.1002/mop.33364 (first published 11 June 2022).

routes_tried: Wiley Online Library, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/mop.33364 and /doi/epdf/: both redirect to the abstract page (no subscription access from the built-in browser)
OpenAlex record of the DOI: oa_status 'closed', no repository copy
Gazi University AVESIS record (avesis.gazi.edu.tr, publication ebb4aad7-8dfb-4640-8e76-8a643eb38e14): abstract and keywords only, no file
access.read: abstract (identical on the Wiley page, in OpenAlex and on AVESIS); AVESIS keywords: double-pass, dual-stage, S-band, thulium-doped fiber amplifier, triple-pass
access.consequence: every entry below comes from the abstract; no material parameter of the doped fiber is available. The authors hold the full text and the OptiSystem project

notes: Category conventions: 'config' = design choice or operating condition of the study (lengths, wavelengths, input power, simulator settings). Material data (cross sections, lifetimes, concentration, waveguide) would be 'lit-other', 'spec' or 'assumed', and a value taken from a simulator default file would carry category 'assumed' with 'OptiSystem default, provenance unknown' in its verification note (cards.validate accepts only the categories of cards.py); none is listed because none is stated in the accessible material. Simulation outputs are kept in 'reported_results' and are not parameters. Level V1 = value and unit confirmed against the abstract of the version of record; V0 = applicability not confirmed.

simulator.applies_to: simulation software and version used for all three designs; component name and model options not stated in the accessible material

verification.note: abstract read 2026-11-18 on the Wiley abstract page and the Gazi AVESIS record; full text not read

length_optimization.value: single parameter single result optimization of OptiSystem; objective: maximum gain; variable: TDF length
length_optimization.applies_to: how the doped-fiber lengths of the designs were chosen; parameter range, step and gain wavelength of the objective not stated in the accessible material

configurations.applies_to: amplifier designs compared in the source

verification.note: abstract only; layouts (positions of circulators, isolators, couplers) not stated in the accessible material

reflector.value: reflector in the double-pass and dual-stage triple-pass designs ('to allow double propagation')
reflector.applies_to: existence of the reflector only; its type, reflectivity, bandwidth and insertion loss are not stated in the accessible material

source.locator: Abstract ('the 1050 nm pump is used in all designs')

lambda_p.applies_to: pump wavelength of all three designs, chosen to provide ground-state and excited-state absorption; pump power and direction not stated in the accessible material

P_in.applies_to: input signal power of the reported results; whether per channel or total, the number of channels and their wavelengths are not stated in the accessible material

verification.note: value confirmed in the abstract; applicability (per channel or total) not confirmed

signal_band.applies_to: signal band; wavelength grid and range not stated in the accessible material

source.locator: Abstract ('two optimized TDF lengths; L1: 5 m and L2: 4.8 m')

L1_DSTP.applies_to: doped-fiber length of the first stage of the dual-stage triple-pass design at the reported 42.77 dB optimum; result of the source's length optimization for maximum gain

verification.note: abstract only; optimum lengths of the single-pass and double-pass designs are not in the abstract

L2_DSTP.applies_to: doped-fiber length of the second stage of the dual-stage triple-pass design at the reported 42.77 dB optimum

reported_results.kind: simulation outputs of the source (OptiSystem 18.0), not measurements and not card parameters

G_DSTP.applies_to: gain of the dual-stage triple-pass design with L1 = 5 m and L2 = 4.8 m at -20 dBm input; signal wavelength, pump power and reference plane not stated in the abstract

NF_DSTP.value: higher than in the single-pass and double-pass designs (no number in the abstract)

bandwidth.value: the dual-stage triple-pass design raises the gain relative to the double-pass design 'without changing the stable bandwidth'; no width, edges or criterion in the abstract

reported_results.manuscript_consistency: rev2.2 l. 221 quotes '42.8 dB of gain for a dual-stage triple-pass S-band TDFA with 1050 nm pumping, at the cost of a higher noise figure'; consistent with the abstract (42.77 dB rounded). Pump power, input power and reference plane are not given there

cross sections: ground-state absorption 3H6->3H5 at 1050 nm; excited-state absorption 3F4->3F2,3 and 3H4->1G4 at 1050 nm; absorption and emission 3H4<->3F4 over the S-band; 3F4<->3H6
whether these spectra and lifetimes are OptiSystem default files (and which ones) or literature data
cross-relaxation and energy-transfer coefficients, if used
background loss at the pump and signal wavelengths

signal wavelengths, channel count, and whether -20 dBm is per channel or total
reflector type, reflectivity and bandwidth; insertion losses of circulators, isolators, WDM couplers and splices
optimum doped-fiber lengths of the single-pass and double-pass designs
ASE spectral grid, ASE directions, longitudinal steps, iterations and convergence tolerance
noise-figure definition and the reference planes of gain and noise figure

completeness.status: abstract-level card: no material parameter and no pump power available; the card documents the design choices stated in the abstract only
required_by_a_full_model: L per stage (L1, L2 of the dual-stage triple-pass design given; the others missing)
N_Tm, doping radius, core radius, NA (or overlap factors)
GSA, ESA and emission cross-section spectra at pump and signal wavelengths, including 1050 nm ESA
background loss at pump and signal
pump power and direction per stage; signal plan and input power per channel
reflector reflectivity and all component losses (reference planes)
completeness.how_to_complete: export the component parameter report of the OptiSystem 18.0 project of [88] (doped-fiber component, pump, reflector, circulators, analyzers, global noise settings) and enter each value with category 'config', 'lit-other' (with reference) or 'assumed'; write 'OptiSystem default, provenance unknown' in the verification note wherever a default file or value was kept

provenance_statement: Whether the doped-fiber data of [88] were OptiSystem defaults could not be determined: the full text was not accessible to this check and the abstract names no data source.

history.change: card created from the abstract (Wiley abstract page, OpenAlex, Gazi AVESIS); full text not accessible

independent spot check: abstract re-read on the Wiley abstract page (version of record); every entry and reported result confirmed; transition marked as not stated in the source; labelling of simulator defaults aligned with the categories of cards.py
